name: Koninklijke Ahold Delhaize N.V.
quirks: Euronext Amsterdam, quoted and reported in EUR millions. 52/53-week retail year ending the Sunday NEAREST Dec 31, so the year-end usually falls in early JANUARY -- period_from_text reads that January calendar year and shifts the annual label a full fiscal year forward (it mislabelled FY2016/FY2020/FY2021/FY2022). The FILENAME is right, the parsed period is wrong. FY2016, FY2020 and FY2026 are 53-week years. FY2016 is a MERGER STUB: Delhaize consolidated only from 24-Jul-2016 (~5 months), so FY2016->FY2017 +26.6% is the merger, not growth -- exclude FY2016 from all CAGRs (use FY2017->FY2025, ~4.9%/yr). IFRS-16 break at FY2018: gross debt jumps 7,250 -> 14,485 purely from lease capitalisation and D&A steps 1,816 -> 2,848, so EBITDA and TotalDebt are not comparable across it. Reported FreeCashFlow is the company's own definition and is NOT OCF - capex: it also deducts lease principal repayments (1,944 FY2025) and net interest (FY2025 reported FCF 2,600 vs OCF-capex 4,425); the filing does not split the lease line into principal and interest. Company-defined NetDebt (14,699 FY2025) INCLUDES leases -- never pair it with the lease-deducted FCF; the DCF uses owner FCF after lease principal against net debt EX-lease (2,725). LeaseLiabilitiesNonCurrent is stored separately in kpis. EPS is basic in EUR per share (not cents). shares_outstanding is period-end for annuals (887M FY2025, down from 1,272M FY2016 on ~EUR1bn/yr buybacks); interims publish only weighted-average basic. CostOfRevenue/GrossProfit are NULL for FY2016/FY2019/FY2020/FY2023 (not disclosed comparably). ~57.5% of sales are USD but the equity is EUR-quoted, so USD/EUR is a first-order driver. The FY2025 annual report's Multiple-year overview (Extracted FY2025 txt, ~lines 2999-3055) prints 10 years of the key series in one internally-consistent table -- use it over the contested worksheet grid.
